subject: Hungry Monkey — correction: earlier closure and reopening alerts were missed
body:
Historical update for Friday 25 September (Gibraltar time):

19:27 check: all three sampled stores were refusing orders.
19:32 check: Essaouira, Era and Royal Calpe were taking orders again, with a long-delays warning.

The closure and reopening alerts should have reached this channel at the time. A monitor fault suppressed both; that detection fault has now been corrected. This message reports those past observations, not a new closure now. The exact closure and reopening times are unknown.

Checks continue every five minutes during tonight's trial. Reopening while delays remain will trigger its own alert, followed by a separate alert when delays clear.

Evidence: https://github.com/nduncx/competitor-watch/actions/runs/36145304829/job/108104867241
